About HeyGen
At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.
About the role
HeyGen is looking for an AI video creator who already lives on the frontier of generative video and has a portfolio to prove it. You'll produce the videos that show the world what HeyGen can do: platform demos, campaign content, social-first videos, and internal projects, from concept to final cut. HeyGen and HyperFrames are your primary tools, but every other model in the stack is there to feed them. This is a full-time contractor role with the opportunity to convert to a permanent position based on performance. We are an in-office work environment.
What you'll do
Produce high-quality AI video for campaigns, internal projects, and platform demos, from concept to final cut, with HeyGen avatars and HyperFrames at the center of the pipeline
Build HyperFrames projects that render deterministic, editable video, and pair them with HeyGen avatars, voices, and translations to deliver finished assets
Maintain deep, current expertise across MCPs and generative video models (Veo, Sora, Seedance, Runway, Kling, Hailuo, Wan, Pika) and know each model's strengths, limits, and sweet spots, and when to route footage into a HeyGen or HyperFrames pipeline
Develop advanced prompting techniques and multi-step pipelines that consistently produce realistic results, and build prompt libraries the team can reuse
Build scroll-stopping hooks in the first 3 seconds and deliver multiple hook and creative variations so the team can test what performs
Write short concepts, shot lists, storyboards, and prompts, and plan scenes before generating so every video has a clear idea
Combine AI footage with traditional editing (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut): captions, subtitles, transitions, effects, basic color, and sound design
Reframe and export every piece in the right format and aspect ratio (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube
Experiment relentlessly: test new models and HeyGen features on release day, benchmark outputs, and turn findings into content ideas and team playbooks
Track short-form trends, formats, and sounds and quickly turn them into content
Who you are
Strong visual eye and storytelling instinct. Your videos communicate, not just impress
Hands-on with HeyGen and HyperFrames: you can take a brief from blank page to rendered MP4 using HeyGen avatars and HyperFrames projects, and you have work that shows it
1+ years creating AI video content (professional, freelance, or prolific personal practice) with a portfolio to prove it
Active creator with 10k+ followers on at least one platform (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X).
Encyclopedic knowledge of current generative video models and a clear POV on when to use which
Exceptional prompting skills: you understand how language and parameters translate to visual output across architectures
Experience building agent-driven video workflows (HyperFrames skills, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI)
Experience with traditional video editing Premiere, After Effects, CapCut)
Contractor Salary Range: $5,000-10,000/month
Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. HeyGen considers factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, as well as location, market and business considerations when extending an offer.
HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Join us at HeyGen and be part of a team that's making visual storytelling accessible to all!

Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.
About the role
HeyGen is hiring a Creator in Residence to own short-form Instagram content and bring consumer-grade viral instinct to the team. The job is to create content yourself, on camera and behind it, shape the overall direction and review of our Instagram series, and hold the taste bar.
HeyGen makes it possible for anyone to produce studio-quality video with AI avatars, in any language, without a camera. Millions of people have made videos with it, and the product moves fast: new avatar models, new formats, new ways to be on screen ship constantly. What we have not yet built is a feed presence that makes people stop scrolling.
In a way, you are the creative director for short-form videos on Instagram. You are not a producer taking briefs, and you are not behind the camera only: you are on it too, as a recurring face of HeyGen's Instagram, and as the human the avatars play off. You are the single DRI for Instagram short-form, and you are measured on whether the content hits.
What you'll do
Own Instagram short-form end to end. You are the DRI for reels: what we make, how often, what it looks like, and whether it worked. Set the editorial calendar, the formats, and the bar.
Bring viral sensibility to the team. Dissect what is spreading on Instagram each week: formats, sounds, pacing, hooks. Turn that into formats we can run, and teach the team to see what you see.
Be on camera. You are one of the faces of HeyGen's Instagram. Film yourself, host formats, react, riff, and put your own personality in the feed. Your avatar will be in the daily series too.
Direct talent, human and avatar. Coach founders, teammates and creators on camera. Write and direct for avatars so they read as a character, not a demo.
Experiment on a schedule. Ship a new format every week, read the numbers, keep what hits, cut what does not.
Make the final creative call. Approve or kill every piece before it ships. When the team disagrees, you decide. Taste is your job, and you are accountable for it.
Report on performance. Own reach, shares, saves and follower growth on Instagram. Know why a post worked and say so.
Who you are
You have made things go viral, repeatedly. A portfolio of short-form videos with real reach, on your own account or a brand's. One hit is luck; we want a pattern.
You have consumer instincts, not B2B ones. You know what a 19-year-old shares with a friend at midnight. You have built an audience of 50k+ on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube, or run an account that did.
You have taste, and you can defend it. You can say why a cut is wrong in one sentence. You hold a bar and other people can feel it.
You are comfortable being the decider. You have led a team or a crew and made calls that other people executed. You do not need to touch every frame to own the result.
You live in the feed. You know this week's sounds, formats and hooks before they peak, and you can tell a trend from a fad.
You are good on camera and you can direct. On-camera talent, founders, and avatars. You write for performance and know how to get a take.
You edit well enough to fix the last 5% yourself. CapCut, Premiere or similar. You do not need to be the fastest editor on the team, but you need to see what the editor missed.
You read numbers without flinching. Reach, shares, saves, retention curves. You change what you make based on what they say.
3+ years making short-form content for social, with at least some of it in a brand or team setting.
Bonus points
You have made AI-generated or avatar-led content that people did not scroll past
You have built a recurring series or character that an audience came back for
You have grown a brand account from zero in a crowded category
You have created for a startup, a tech product, or the creator economy
How this role works
We run creative on a 15/80/5 model, and this role sits at both ends of it.
Phase
Share of the work
Who
What happens
Concept
First 15%
You, deep in it
Hook, premise, format, casting, the reason anyone would watch
Production
Middle 80%
Team executes
Shooting, avatar generation, editing, captions, scheduling
Final call
Last 5%
You, back in it
Review every cut, fix what is close, kill what is not, approve what ships
You are the DRI for Instagram short-form. That means one name on the result, not a committee. You will work closely with brand, product marketing and the avatar team, and you will have editors and producers to execute. The creative call is yours.
What success looks like in the first 90 days
The avatar daily series is live, consistent and growing week over week
Instagram reach and shares are up measurably from the day you started
At least one format has clearly broken out and become a repeatable franchise
The team can name the three things you changed about how we judge creative
Why HeyGen
The most interesting tool a creator has ever had. You will make content with avatars, voices and formats that did not exist a year ago, and you will have the people who build them down the hall.
Real creative authority. You make the call. No creative review by committee, no six-week approval chain.
A product people already love. You are not inventing demand. You are showing millions of people what is possible in a way they cannot ignore.
A team that ships. We move at the speed of the feed and we expect you to pull us faster.
Competitive salary, equity, health coverage, and the equipment you need. Hybrid in San Francisco or Los Angeles.
HeyGen considers factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, as well as location, market and business considerations when extending an offer.
HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Join us at HeyGen and be part of a team that's making visual storytelling accessible to all!
